returns.artistApproved: whether the returned version is artist-approved

returns.fanRank: 1..96 when the account holds a seat, else 0
returns.isArtist: account is the artist root authority

ARTIST_RANK().notice: Role rank of the artist (root authority).

MAX_FAN_RANK().notice: Maximum number of ranked superfan/editor seats per artist.

PHI_SCALE().notice: Fixed-point scale for phi weights (36 decimals — 1e18 would         collapse the lowest ranks toward zero).

activePendingId(bytes32,bytes32).notice: The single active PENDING proposal per content item (0 = none).         By construction it is always the strongest eligible pending proposal.

approveContribution(bytes32,uint64).notice: Artist approves any pending contribution — including a weaker-ranked         one while a stronger pending proposal exists. Artist judgment is final.         Grants the contributor +1 reputation, exactly once per approval.

approvedContributionCount(bytes32,addres.notice: Earned reputation: artist-approved contribution count per editor address.         Belongs to the address forever — never transfers with a rank.

artistIdFromSlug(string).notice: Derive the stable artist id from the canonical slug.

artistPublish(bytes32,bytes32,bytes32,st.notice: Artist publishes a new canonical, artist-approved version in one step,         regardless of any pending proposals or phi weights (invariant A).         Pending fan proposals remain pending as proposed future corrections.

assignFan(bytes32,uint8,address).notice: Artist seats a fan at an empty rank.

canonicalApprovedId(bytes32,bytes32).notice: Latest artist-approved contribution per content item (0 = none — legacy seed applies).

canonicalOf(bytes32,bytes32).notice: Canonical resolution for a content item (invariant B):         1. latest artist-approved version;         2. else the strongest eligible pending proposal;         3. else 0 — render the legacy/AI seed content.

contractOwner().notice: Platform steward. Can ONLY register artists — no content backdoor.

fanAtRank(bytes32,uint8).notice: artistId => rank (1..96) => fan address (0 = empty seat)

phiWeightX36(uint8).notice: phiWeight(roleRank) = 100 / phi^(roleRank + 1), in 1e36 fixed point.         roleRank 0 = artist (~61.803e36), 1..96 = fan seats.         Deterministic iterated multiplication — the rank itself remains the         definitive ordering; this value is a display/snapshot score.

rankOf(bytes32,address).notice: artistId => address => rank (0 = no seat held)

registerArtist(string,address).notice: Register a new artist page. Contract-owner only (its sole power).

rejectContribution(bytes32,uint64).notice: Artist rejects a pending contribution. No reputation is granted.

removeFan(bytes32,uint8).notice: Artist removes/revokes the fan seated at `rank`.         Historical contributions and earned reputation are untouched.

roleOf(bytes32,address).notice: Role of an account on an artist page, for the frontend role gate.

strongestPendingOf(bytes32,bytes32).notice: The strongest (and only) active pending proposal for an item, 0 if none.

submitContribution(bytes32,bytes32,bytes.notice: Submit a versioned contribution (proposal) for a content item.         Callable by the artist or any seated fan of this page.         Supersede rule (invariant C), enforced on-chain:         a fan may replace the active pending proposal only when they are         the same contributor (revising their own draft) or hold a strictly         stronger (lower) rank than the pending proposal's snapshot rank.         The artist bypasses the rule entirely (invariant A).

transferArtistRole(bytes32,address).notice: Voluntary artist role transfer. ONLY the current artist can do this —         not the contract owner, not anyone else (artist sovereignty).         History (contributions, approvals, reputation) is untouched.

transferContractOwnership(address).notice: Two-step transfer of the platform-steward role.

transferFanRank(bytes32,address).notice: A fan transfers their own seat (rank + phiWeight move; earned         reputation and historical attribution do NOT move).
